note: Two Garden bugs fixed. (1) Quality toggle Seed Garden FullBloom buttons now actually change the rendered scene. Was: counts were baked into createStarfield createRingParticles createLuminos at mesh-build time so changing qualityLevel at runtime updated the variable but did not reach the visual layer. Same load-path-not-reaching-visual-layer class as the v5.43.9 Garden hydrate bug. Fix: build all particle systems at MAX count (4000 stars 500 ring particles 800 halo per Luminos 200 trail) and gate at runtime via qualityScale 0.2 0.5 1.0 multiplier plus geometry.setDrawRange for starfield ring particles and trail plus activeHaloCount qualityScale multiplier in the per-frame halo render. applyQualityToMeshes called from setQuality from init after buildWorld so the saved choice is honored on first render and from the auto-quality-reduction path when FPS drops. applyQualityToMeshes exposed on publicAPI. (2) Luminos colors froze because app.html patchGardenInit unconditionally set bridgeActive true when Garden initialized even when there were no pending emotion vectors. This disabled the demo emotion cycle forever blocking color changes whenever chat was not actively feeding emotions. Fix: gate the setBridgeActive true call on actual pending-vector flush in patchGardenInit. Plus add bridgeActive auto-expire in fractal-garden.js: BRIDGE_EXPIRE_MS 30000 lastEmotionFeedTime updated in feedEmotionalEnergy cycleEmotions resets bridgeActive false after 30 seconds of no real feed. Real chat keeps re-arming the bridge. Chat silence resumes demo cycling. Garden never stalls. 15 new smoke locks: qualityScale defined applyQualityToMeshes defined applyQualityToMeshes called from setQuality called from init starfield built at 4000 ring particles at 500 halo at 800 trail at 200 animateLuminos uses qualityScale starfield uses setDrawRange applyQualityToMeshes exposed on publicAPI BRIDGE_EXPIRE_MS defined feedEmotionalEnergy updates lastEmotionFeedTime cycleEmotions auto-expires bridge patchGardenInit only activates bridge with pending flush. 1670 to 1685 checks pass. Triple-bumped FL_VERSION flCurrentVersion span both sw.js CACHE_NAME and this version.json. Kirk asked to look at both bugs Harmonia identified. The Garden is truly starting to glow.
